usb: USB 3.2 Gen1 SuperSpeed Host/Device (5 Gbps, PHY integrated) + USB 2.0 HS Host/Device (480 Mbps, PHY integrated) + USB 2.0 FS OTG (PHY integrated) + USB PD/Type-C controller + PHY
eth: 10/100/1000 MAC + 10/100 PHY (integrated); RGMII for external 1000M PHY
timers: 2× 16-bit advanced, 4× 16-bit + 4× 32-bit general-purpose, 2× 16-bit basic, 2× LPTIM, IWDG + WWDG, 2× 32-bit SysTick, RTC
notes: Dual core: QingKe V5F (out-of-order multi-issue, 32 KB I-cache) up to 400 MHz and QingKe V3F up to 160 MHz; both RV32IMAFBC-X with single-precision FPU.
V5F 500 MHz / V3F 200 MHz in LDO performance mode is specified for commercial-grade use only (TA <= 70 °C, good heat dissipation).
SRAM 896 KB = 128 KB ITCM + 256 KB DTCM (V5F) + 512 KB shared code/data area.
CodeFlash is non-zero-wait (about 25 MHz equivalent); zero-wait code areas are ITCM and the shared SRAM; DBMODE bit selects 960 KB user flash/56 KB boot or 480 KB/28 KB.
ADC/TouchKey share channels (2x 12-bit ADC, 5 Msps); plus one 10-bit 20 Msps HSADC.
Other blocks: I3C, SAI, SWPMI, DFSDM, GPHA graphics accelerator, RNG, ECDC (AES-128/192/256, SM4), 2x LPTIM.

VDD33 2.4-3.6 V (3.15-3.45 V when USB2/Ethernet/SerDes used); VDD33A 1.8-3.6 V; VDD12A/VDDK 1.17-1.27 V; VDDIO 1.65-3.6 V; VIO18 high-speed I/O 1.1-3.6 V (1.2/1.8/2.5/3.3 V selectable); VBAT 1.8-3.6 V.
2x QSPI (memory-mapped mode); FMC with FSMC and SDRAM interfaces; SDIO and SDMMC both present.
Remote SerDes (kV-level isolated link, up to 100 m cable), UHSIF 32-bit 125 MHz parallel interface, PIOC, LTDC, DVP.
3 OPA/PGA/CMP blocks plus 1 analog comparator; 7-channel HSADC.

OPA1 and OPA3 only.

usb: USB 2.0 HS Host/Device (480 Mbps, PHY integrated) + USB PD/Type-C controller + PHY

notes: SRAM 64/96/128 KB configurable via user option against the zero-wait code area (80/48/16 KB zero-wait); ramKB is the maximum.
ICache 16 KB; BootLoader 32 KB; DataFlash 32 KB.

Supply: single 3.3 V on VDD33 (3.0-3.6 V; 3.2-3.4 V when USB or Ethernet is used) or single 5 V on V5 (4.0-5.25 V, internal 3.3 V regulator) where the V5 pin exists; GPIO supply VDDIO 1.1-3.6 V; some pins 5 V tolerant.
Low-power modes: Sleep and Deep sleep.
Also has an 8-bit passive parallel port (SLV); UART0 supports MODEM signals; UARTs up to 12 Mbps.
CodeFlash: datasheet V1.0 lists 192 KB; Dec-2025 selection guide lists 448 KB for CH564L/Q/F (192 KB for CH564C). Newest document used.
XBUS external bus (A0-A19, D0-D31) available on this package.
